# Architecture Decision Record (ADR)

The record has been drafted and saved to [`docs/adr/0001-floating-island-character-os-and-modular-connectors.md`](https://github.com/su-axisync/draft-an-architecture-decision-record-ad/blob/main/docs/adr/0001-floating-island-character-os-and-modular-connectors.md) with an index in [`README.md`](https://github.com/su-axisync/draft-an-architecture-decision-record-ad/blob/main/README.md).

***

## ADR-0001: Architecture of the Interactive Floating Island Overlay with Decoupled 3D Character Skin ("B-Bot") and Modular Utility Pipeline

- **Status**: Accepted
- **Date**: 2026-11-06
- **Category**: Intelligent Interface / Desktop Assistant & System Utilities
- **Project**: B-Bot (The Character OS) / Floating Island

---

### 1. Title and Short Context (What Forces the Decision)

Users constantly switch between disconnected tools during desktop workflows: AI assistants locked in web tabs/sidebars, native file-sharing tools (AirDrop/Bluetooth), and format conversion utilities. At the same time, conversational AI lacks a persistent, embodied physical presence on the screen. Existing avatar solutions tightly couple 3D models with proprietary, hardcoded AI backends, blocking users from using their preferred AI providers or privacy-centric local models.

#### Key Driving Forces
* **Embodied Spatial Presence**: The assistant must live persistently as a top-layer "Liquid Glass" Floating Island without obstructing active windows or draining system battery.
* **Bring-Your-Own-AI (BYO-AI)**: The 3D character skin (**RON**, a fluid-clay avatar) must be strictly decoupled from the intelligence layer so users can plug in any AI provider (OpenAI, Claude, Ollama/local models) via modular API connectors.
* **Micro-Utility Friction**: Frequent desktop operations—dispatching files via AirDrop/Bluetooth and universal on-the-fly file conversion—must be consolidated into an effortless drag-and-drop target.
* **Rendering & Integration Realities**: The 3D fluid-clay shader pipeline requires cross-platform support (GLB/USDZ) and integration with OS automations (Apple Shortcuts).

---

### 2. Decision (What We Decided)

We decided to implement a **Decoupled Embodied Overlay Architecture** organized into five core modules:

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    subgraph Desktop Layer ["Top-Layer Desktop Display"]
        Island["Persistent Floating Island (Liquid Glass Shell)"]
        Avatar["RON: 3D Fluid-Clay Character Skin (GLB / USDZ)"]
        DropTarget["Drag & Drop File Dropzone"]
    end

    subgraph Core Engine ["Runtime IPC & Event Dispatcher"]
        StateManager["Island Window & Layout State Engine"]
        EmoEngine["EmoLang Animation & Shader Controller"]
        FileRouter["Drop Payload Inspection & Router"]
    end

    subgraph Service Modules ["Decoupled Service Modules"]
        AIModule["Modular AI Connector Hub (BYO-AI: OpenAI / Claude / Ollama)"]
        ConvertModule["Universal Local Conversion Engine (MIME Type Presets)"]
        TransferModule["Dispatch Engine (AirDrop / Bluetooth OBEX)"]
        ShortcutsModule["OS Automation Bridge (Apple Shortcuts Runner)"]
    end

    Island --> Avatar
    Island --> DropTarget
    DropTarget --> FileRouter
    Avatar --> EmoEngine
    StateManager --> Island

    FileRouter -->|Convert Request| ConvertModule
    FileRouter -->|Transfer Request| TransferModule
    EmoEngine <-->|Sentiment & Token Stream| AIModule
    ShortcutsModule -->|System Triggers| StateManager
```

1. **Top-Layer Floating Island Shell**:
   * A persistent, transparent, always-on-top desktop window overlay with dynamic hit-testing (click-through when idling; reactive drop-zone and dialog dial upon hover or file drag).
2. **Modular BYO-AI Connector Hub**:
   * An abstract interface (`IAIConnector`) standardizing streaming text, multimodal inputs, and emotion metadata. Users configure API keys or local endpoint URLs to animate RON.
   * **EmoLang Parser**: Translates AI sentiment tags and tokens into dynamic fluid-clay shader perturbations, morph targets, and facial expressions in real time.
3. **3D Fluid-Clay Shader & Asset Pipeline**:
   * **GLB (glTF 2.0)** as the primary cross-platform 3D format, with **USDZ** export for native Apple Metal optimization.
   * Variable-framerate throttling (0–1 fps during ambient resting states; ramping to 60/120 fps upon interaction) to prevent thermal throttling and battery drain.
4. **Drag-and-Drop Radial Utility Dial**:
   * **AirDrop & Bluetooth Dispatch**: Inspects dropped files and dispatches them to pre-set contacts or nearby Mac/PC hardware.
   * **Universal Converter Engine**: Detects source file formats, displays a quick target format picker, and executes conversions locally using sandboxed utilities (e.g., `ffmpeg`, `pandoc`, `vips`).
5. **OS Automation & Apple Shortcuts Integration**:
   * A bidirectional bridge via an internal URI scheme (`island://action/...`) and native CLI runner (`shortcuts run`) to trigger macros and respond to system states.

---

### 3. Consequences (Trade-offs: What We Gain and Give Up)

#### What We Gain (+)
* **Provider Freedom (BYO-AI)**: Users are not locked into a single AI ecosystem; any AI can be equipped with the "RON" fluid-clay 3D skin.
* **Unified Workspace Ergonomics**: File sharing, format conversion, and conversational AI are anchored to one single, muscle-memory screen location.
* **Tactile Emotional UX**: EmoLang-driven 3D fluid-clay animations transform static chat text into an embodied companion experience.
* **Local Privacy & Speed**: File conversion and local LLM routing operate on-device without external server uploads.

#### What We Give Up / Trade-offs (-)
* **Resource Footprint**: Keeping a real-time 3D shader and transparent window active requires more memory (80–180 MB) and GPU attention than standard menu-bar utilities. Requires aggressive frame-skipping when idle.
* **OS Compatibility Gaps**: AirDrop and Apple Shortcuts are macOS-specific; cross-platform targets (Windows/Linux) require fallback pathways (Bluetooth OBEX, LocalSend, Power Automate).
* **Converter Package Size**: Bundling universal conversion binaries locally increases application installer size (mitigated by downloading converter modules on demand).
* **Asset Pipeline Overhead**: Supporting both GLB and USDZ formats requires dual-format asset build steps.

---

### 4. Alternatives Considered and Why Rejected

| Alternative | Description | Reason for Rejection |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Monolithic Fixed-LLM App** | An Electron desktop chat client bundled with a single proprietary LLM and a static avatar. | **Rejected**: Violates the BYO-AI requirement, forces ongoing subscription dependencies, lacks spatial desktop presence, and offers no drag-and-drop file utilities. |
| **Menu Bar / System Tray App with 2D Sprites** | Confining the assistant and drop target to a status icon in the macOS menu bar / Windows tray using 2D Lottie animations. | **Rejected**: Poor drag-and-drop ergonomics across large monitors; 2D sprites cannot provide the tactile fluid-clay depth or liquid-glass aesthetic required by B-Bot. |
| **Browser Extension Widget** | A floating WebGL island injected into browser pages. | **Rejected**: Restricted exclusively to browser tabs; cannot float across native desktop apps, cannot access system AirDrop/Bluetooth, and cannot run OS shortcuts. |
| **Cloud Pixel-Streamed Avatar** | Rendering the 3D fluid-clay character on remote GPUs and streaming video back via WebRTC. | **Rejected**: Introduce high network latency, requires constant internet access, incurs high recurring GPU server costs, and introduces security risks by transmitting local files over the wire. |

***

*All changes are committed and pushed to the repository.*

Berikut adalah teks penuh ADR dalam **Bahasa Melayu Sains Moden & Teknikal**:

***

# Rekod Keputusan Senibina (ADR)

## ADR-0001: Senibina Antara Muka Tindanan Pulau Terapung (Floating Island) dengan Kulit Karakter 3D Terlerai ("B-Bot") dan Saluran Paip Utiliti Rentas Platform

* **Status**: Diterima (*Accepted*) — 2026-11-06
* **Kategori**: Antara Muka Pintar / Pembantu Ruang Kerja Digital (*Intelligent Interface / Workspace Assistant*)
* **Produk**: B-Bot (*The Character OS*) / Pulau Terapung (*Floating Island*)

---

### 1. Tajuk dan Konteks Ringkas (Daya Penggerak & Kekangan Keputusan)

Aliran kerja digital harian mewujudkan fragmentasi produktiviti apabila pengguna terpaksa beralih konteks secara berulang antara aplikasi perbualan AI (yang terhad di dalam tab pelayar web atau tetingkap sembang terasing), utiliti pemindahan fail fizikal (AirDrop / Bluetooth), dan alat penukaran format fail pihak ketiga. Model pembantu kecerdasan buatan sedia ada tidak mempunyai kehadiran spatial fizikal yang berterusan di lapisan atas skrin (*desktop overlay*).

Pada masa yang sama, avatar 3D komersial lazimnya terikat secara tegar (*tightly coupled*) kepada model bahasa raya (LLM) proprietari tertentu. Ini menghalang pengguna daripada menyepadukan model kecerdasan buatan pilihan mereka sendiri (*Bring Your Own AI* — BYO-AI), seperti penyedia API komersial mahupun model tempatan berorientasikan privasi (Ollama / GGUF).

Bagi merealisasikan ekosistem **B-Bot (The Character OS)** yang berpusatkan watak pembantu tanah liat bendalir 3D (**RON**) dengan estetika Kaca Cecair (*Liquid Glass*), satu keputusan senibina diperlukan untuk menangani integrasi menyeluruh merentasi pelbagai sistem operasi (**macOS, Windows, Linux, dan Android Mobile**).

#### Status Fasa & Aset Projek
* **Wawasan Reka Bentuk (*Design Vision*)**: Selesai (*Done*)
* **Skrip Suai Tugas (*Onboarding Script*)**: Selesai (*Done*)
* **Fasa Semasa**: Pembangunan Teduh 3D (*3D Shader Development*)
* **Aset Tersedia**: Olok-olok Kaca Cecair (*Liquid Glass Mockups*), Skrip EmoLang, Dialog Suai Tugas Tersuai.
* **Kekangan & Butiran Kritikal yang Perlu Diselesaikan**:
  1. Spesifikasi model 3D (ketiadaan fail model GLB / USDZ diselesaikan melalui saluran paip piawaian dwi-format).
  2. Integrasi automasi sistem (Apple Shortcuts pada macOS/iOS, serta Android Intents, Windows URI Scheme, dan Linux D-Bus).
  3. Keupayaan penghantaran fail dwiarah (AirDrop & Bluetooth OBEX) ke kenalan, MacBook, PC Windows, dan peranti Android.
  4. Enjin penukaran format fail sejagat (*Universal File Converter*) seret dan lepas berasaskan pemprosesan setempat.

---

### 2. Keputusan Senibina (Apa yang Diputuskan)

Kami memutuskan untuk mengguna pakai **Senibina Tindanan Terlerai Berbilang Lapisan (*Decoupled Multi-Layered Overlay Architecture*)** yang memisahkan antara muka paparan, enjin visual watak, modul ketersambungan AI, serta saluran paip utiliti sistem:

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    subgraph LapisanTindanan ["Lapisan Tindanan Paparan Atas Skrin (Top-Layer Screen Overlay)"]
        PulauTerapung["Kompang Pulau Terapung (Cangkerang Kaca Cecair / Liquid Glass)"]
        Avatar3D["RON: Kulit Karakter 3D Tanah Liat Bendalir (GLB / USDZ)"]
        ZonSeretLepas["Zon Sasaran Seret & Lepas (Drag & Drop Receptor Zone)"]
    end

    subgraph EnjinPenyelarasan ["Enjin Teras & Penyelaras Acara (Core Runtime & IPC Bridge)"]
        PengurusKeadaan["Pengurus Keadaan Tetingkap & Antara Muka (State Manager)"]
        EnjinEmoLang["Penyahkod EmoLang & Pengawal Animasi/Teduh (Shader Controller)"]
        PenghalaFail["Pemeriksa MIME & Penghala Muatan Fail (File Payload Router)"]
    end

    subgraph ModulPerkhidmatan ["Modul Perkhidmatan Terlerai (Decoupled Services)"]
        PenyambungAI["Hab Penyambung API AI Modular (BYO-AI: OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, API Tersuai)"]
        EnjinPenukaran["Enjin Penukaran Format Sejagat (Universal Local File Converter)"]
        SubsistemPenghantaran["Sub-sistem Penghantaran Rentas Peranti (AirDrop / Bluetooth OBEX / Soket LAN)"]
        JambatanAutomasi["Jambatan Automasi Sistem (Apple Shortcuts / Android Intents / D-Bus / WinSDK)"]
    end

    PulauTerapung --> Avatar3D
    PulauTerapung --> ZonSeretLepas
    ZonSeretLepas --> PenghalaFail
    Avatar3D --> EnjinEmoLang
    PengurusKeadaan --> PulauTerapung

    PenghalaFail -->|Niat Penukaran Format| EnjinPenukaran
    PenghalaFail -->|Niat Penghantaran Fail| SubsistemPenghantaran
    EnjinEmoLang <-->|Penyegerakan Emosi & Sentimen| PenyambungAI
    PenyambungAI -->|Penstriman Token & Teg Emosi| PengurusKeadaan
    JambatanAutomasi -->|Pencetus Makro Sistem| PengurusKeadaan
```

#### Komponen Utama Keputusan:

1. **Cangkerang Pulau Terapung (*Floating Island Shell*)**:
   * Dilaksanakan menggunakan enjin natif ringan berakselerasi GPU (Tauri / Rust dengan cangkuk tetingkap lutsinar natif, Metal pada macOS, DirectComposition pada Windows, dan Wayland/X11 subsurfaces pada Linux).
   * Melaksanakan ujian perlanggaran kursor dinamik (*dynamic hit-testing*): lutsinar sepenuhnya terhadap klik tetikus semasa mod melahu (*idle pass-through*), dan bertukar menjadi zon interaktif aktif apabila kursor atau fail menghampiri sempadan pulau.

2. **Hab Penyambung API AI Modular (*BYO-AI Architecture*)**:
   * Kulit watak 3D diasingkan sepenuhnya daripada penyedia model AI melalui antara muka standard (`IAIConnectorBridge`).
   * Pengguna bebas mengkonfigurasi kunci API pihak ketiga (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini) atau pelayan inferens tempatan luar talian (Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM).
   * **Penyahkod EmoLang**: Memproses bait metadata emosi daripada respons AI untuk mengubah parameter teduh bendalir (*fluid viscosity, surface tension, refraction*) serta sasaran bentuk gabungan (*blendshapes*) karakter RON secara masa nyata.

3. **Saluran Paip Aset 3D & Teduh (*Shader & Asset Pipeline*)**:
   * **Piawaian Dwi-Model**:
     * **GLB (glTF 2.0 Binary)**: Format sejagat merentasi platform (Windows, Linux, Android, WebGL/WebGPU) yang mengandungi jaring poligon dioptimumkan dan tekstur mampat.
     * **USDZ**: Format dioptimumkan untuk subsistem Apple (macOS dan iOS) bagi pemaparan Metal/RealityKit tanpa beban terjemahan format.
   * **Kawalan Tenaga Rendah Dinamik**: Kadar bingkai pemaparan diturunkan ke 0–1 fps semasa fasa melahu (*ambient sleep*) untuk memelihara hayat bateri komputer riba dan peranti mudah alih, dan meningkat secara lancar ke 60/120 fps semasa interaksi aktif.

4. **Saluran Paip Utiliti Seret & Lepas (AirDrop / Bluetooth & Penukaran Sejagat)**:
   * **Penghantaran Fail (*Dispatch Engine*)**: Mengesan fail yang diseret untuk dipindahkan terus kepada kenalan atau peranti yang telah dipratetap:
     * macOS / iOS: Panggilan API natif AirDrop (`NSSharingServicePicker`).
     * Windows / Linux / Android: Protokol Bluetooth OBEX disokong oleh protokol rangkaian p2p (*LocalSend / Wi-Fi Direct*) untuk pemindahan berkelajuan tinggi.
   * **Penukaran Format Sejagat (*Universal Converter Engine*)**: Menentusahkan jenis MIME sumber dan memaparkan roda pemilih format sasaran (dokumen, audio, video, imej, arkib). Penukaran diproses secara dalaman menggunakan binari terbenam setempat (`ffmpeg`, `libvips`, `pandoc`) tanpa memuat naik data pengguna ke awan.

5. **Jambatan Automasi Rentas Sistem Operasi**:
   * **macOS**: Integrasi Apple Shortcuts dwiarah melalui utiliti baris perintah `/usr/bin/shortcuts run`.
   * **Android**: Pelaksanaan buih tindanan terapung sistem (*System Overlay Window / Foreground Service*) bersama penyiaran `Intent` eksplisit.
   * **Windows**: Pengendali Protokol URI (`island://action`) berasaskan Windows App SDK dan PowerShell.
   * **Linux**: Komunikasi antara proses berasaskan D-Bus piawai (*org.freedesktop.FileManager1* dan *org.freedesktop.Notifications*).

---

### 3. Implikasi & Kompromi (Consequences)

#### Keuntungan & Kelebihan Senibina (+)
* **Kebebasan Ekosistem Model**: Pengguna tidak terikat dengan mana-mana model komersial; mana-mana enjin AI boleh diberikan jasad kulit 3D RON.
* **Ergonomik Spatial Berpusat**: Menggabungkan interaksi kecerdasan buatan, pemindahan fail, dan penukaran format ke dalam satu koordinat skrin yang sentiasa boleh dicapai.
* **Kedaulatan Privasi Data**: Fail yang ditukar format dan arahan inferens tempatan diproses 100% pada peranti pengguna (*on-device execution*).
* **Emosi Interaktif Organik**: Gabungan peneduh kaca cecair dan skrip EmoLang menghasilkan watak digital yang hidup dan responsif secara fizikal.

#### Kekurangan, Risiko & Kompromi (-)
* **Beban Penggunaan Memori & GPU**: Peneduh 3D berterusan memerlukan peruntukan RAM asas (anggaran 90–200 MB). Memerlukan mekanisma pembekuan bingkai (*sleep-state*) yang ketat semasa melahu.
* **Asimetri Protokol Sistem Operasi**: Ketiadaan sokongan rasmi AirDrop pada sistem bukan Apple memaksa penyelenggaraan saluran komunikasi sandaran (Bluetooth OBEX & LAN soket).
* **Saiz Pemasang Tempatan**: Pakej perisian boleh membesar sekiranya kesemua pustaka penukaran format dibundel sekali gus (diatasi dengan kaedah pemalam muat turun atas permintaan).
* **Pengendalian Tetingkap Skrin Penuh**: Tetingkap tindanan berisiko terganggu oleh mod skrin penuh (*full-screen exclusive*), takuk kamera (*notch*), dan susunan berbilang monitor.

---

### 4. Alternatif yang Dipertimbangkan dan Sebab Penolakan

| Alternatif | Huraian Reka Bentuk | Sebab Penolakan |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Aplikasi Sembang Desktop Monolitik Tertutup** | Aplikasi tetingkap standard Electron yang dibundel bersama model LLM komersial tetap dan avatar 2D. | **Ditolak**: Menyalahi visi teras BYO-AI, mengenakan kos langganan berulang kepada pengguna, tiada kehadiran spatial atas skrin, serta ketiadaan utiliti seret-lepas fail. |
| **Ikon Bar Menu / Dulang Sistem (*System Tray*) dengan Animasi Lottie 2D** | Mengehadkan fungsi watak dan zon seret-lepas ke dalam ikon menu bar sistem bersama grafik vektor 2D. | **Ditolak**: Sukar dijadikan sasaran jatuhan kursor pada monitor luas; animasi 2D tidak mampu menghasilkan kedalaman pembiasan kaca cecair dan sifat fizikal bendalir tanah liat karakter RON. |
| **Widget Pelayar Web Terapung (*Browser Extension*)** | Widget berasaskan WebGL yang disuntik ke dalam laman web pelayar internet. | **Ditolak**: Terkurung di dalam pelayar web sahaja (tidak berfungsi merentas aplikasi desktop OS), tiada akses kepada API perkakasan AirDrop, Bluetooth, atau sistem fail setempat. |
| **Avatar Penstriman Piksel Awan (*Cloud Pixel Streaming / WebRTC*)** | Merender watak 3D di pelayan awan GPU dan menstrim video interaktif ke komputer pengguna. | **Ditolak**: Menjana sela masa input (*latency*) yang ketara, memerlukan sambungan internet berterusan, kos pelayan GPU awan yang tinggi, serta risiko kebocoran privasi semasa memindahkan fail tempatan. |
